title: Cabbage Man
text: And so, one evening as winter was drawing near…
“Naofumi-chan, what’s for dinner tonight? Oh, by the way, we all finished tending the garden.”
“Thank you, Sadeena-san.”
“Oh, come on, Naofumi-chan—you can just call me Sadeena. Or would you prefer ‘you’?”
“Hmm… I think I’d still rather call you Sadeena-san.”
“Oh my—”
“What would you like to eat tonight, Raphtalia-chan? Is there anything you’d like to eat, Imiya-chan?”
“Rafu?”
My father is chatting amiably with my Big Sisters while they handle various chores around the village.
“Uh, well…”
My Big Sister and Mole are standing side by side, talking with Father. It’s true—when the young Big Sister and Mole are together, their reactions do look quite similar.
“You see, Imiya-chan worked really hard alongside Raphtalia-chan to tend the fields.”
“Thank you both for doing that every day.”
“Ah, yes…”

By the way, it seems Mole is studying tailoring because she wants to learn a new skill. She keeps asking me and my Rival all sorts of questions. That’s the kind of thing Father is asking Big Sister and the Mole, but their gazes aren’t fixed on him—they’re focused on a single Point. Thud! Thud-thud! Squish! Squishhhhh! Thud-thud! Thud! Thud! Sounds like that are echoing all around.
“Eeeeeek…”
“Hii…”
A little ways off, Ren and Itsuki are letting out screams.
“Oh my…?”
Then… supported by Elephant, Panda comes over, clutching his stomach and dripping with cold sweat, and glares at my Father. Even Rival has flown over again.
“Hey! You!”
Panda yells at my Father.
“That again? I did have a dedicated healer and midwife from Siltvelt check me out, didn’t I?”

Father replied to the panda, furrowing his brow in exasperation. Lately, the panda has been grilling Father like this every day. Itsuki and Ren, who had disappeared for a while, look terrified the moment they return. This is what you’d call a mental issue caused by pregnancy.
“I’ll say it as many times as it takes! What did you put inside me?! Kuu… uuuu!”
Boom! Panda lurched backward, her belly bulging out dramatically.
“Even if you say that…”
Father also seemed at a loss as to how to handle the situation.
“I’m sure a creature is going to burst out of my belly any day now! Naofumi, you weren’t human after all!”
Itsuki pointed at my Father and began to denounce him.
“What are you talking about? My Father is a perfectly normal human being!”
“Coming from you—someone whose humanity is questionable—that’s not very convincing!”
Lately, Itsuki’s supernatural powers have been growing stronger. Maybe it’s about time we taught her a lesson in knowing her place?
“As for my Big Sister and the Panda, they’re pregnant, so there’s nothing strange about it at all.”
“You’re still saying that after seeing this?! There’s a limit to everything, isn’t there?!”
Even Ren jumped in, pointing at Big Sister’s older sister’s belly and the Panda’s belly. By the way, the sound we heard earlier was coming from their bellies.
“If I recall correctly… according to legend, the children of the Hero are said to be exceptionally gifted.”
Elephant joined the conversation at this point.

“Come to think of it, I feel like I’ve heard stories like that before. It was about how you have to be really careful about who you get involved with, or how it could lead to a succession dispute, right? I confessed to Sadeena because I like her, though…”
“This isn’t even on the same level as ‘gifted’ or ‘energetic’ kids! This is something else entirely!”
“Exactly! It wouldn’t be the least bit surprising if the baby burst right out of its mother’s belly at any moment!”
“Uuuuugh…”
Panda looks pale and is clutching his stomach. Just then, the Rival landed right next to Panda.
“Don’t worry, Panda. The baby won’t burst out of her belly—it’ll just be an overly energetic kid. But you said something similar to Naofumi in another loop, didn’t you?”
“Expecting me to feel reassured by that… isn’t that a bit much?!”
“Oh my—even though Big Sister and Naofumi-chan’s baby hasn’t been born yet, it’s already so full of energy. It’s so energetic even before it’s born that it actually puts my mind at ease.”
Big Sister’s belly jiggles violently. By the way, lately, Big Sister and Panda have been in their Beastman forms the whole time.
“Rest assured…”
“Um…”
Big Sister and Mole’s eyes are glued to Big Sister’s belly.
“Gaelion-san! Is this happening in the other loops as well!?”
“I can’t believe it!”
Itsuki and Ren ask their Rival—and turn to ask me, too.
“That’s right… I do recall that most of my Father’s children were full of energy.”

“So this is a confirmed phenomenon!?　Naofumi-san. The suspicion that you’re not human is growing stronger by the minute! So the reason the Shield Hero is favored by monsters is because the Shield Hero himself isn’t human, right?! Are you a monster from another world that looks just like a human?! You’re the Demon King, aren’t you?!”
“Itsuki… and Ren too—let’s talk over there.”
As Itsuki loudly accuses him, my Father gives off a faint aura of killing intent and gently guides them away with a smile. That’s the same aura my Father gave off when he scolded Kou!

“Loops have all sorts of possibilities. By the way, in the first ‘Wild Naofumi’ world, the child of Naofumi and Sadeena was the village’s biggest troublemaker and used to play with Imiya-neechan’s child all the time.”
“Huh!?”
At this point, all eyes turn to Mole, who looks around nervously. His face looks pale.
“Don’t worry, Imiya. The child you have with Naofumi will grow to be exceptionally huge even among the Ruumo race—they’ll have a build on par with Sadeena’s.”
“That’s way too big! How am I supposed to feel at ease with that?!”
“That’s more than twice Imiya’s size! That’s definitely a monster!”
“Uh… well, that…”
“Setting Sadeena’s kids aside, Imiya-onee-chan’s child will be a well-behaved, capable kid.”
“That’s not the point!”
“No… well, you see—”
My rival is gazing up at the sky, lost in memories. There are limits to how much one can refuse to accept defeat!
“By the way, Naofumi—who loved Gaelion—and Gaelion’s child, along with the Panda’s child, used to play together happily. Those were the days.”
“Gaelion! Did you also carry a child like this?”
“Hehe… Most of Naofumi’s children are lively and full of energy like this.”
My rival nodded as if to agree.
“I see. So Naofumi-san really is…”
“Itsuki, if you don’t cut it out, I’ll rip off your upgraded headphones and awaken you!”
Ignoring his father-in-law’s murderous aura, Itsuki continues his analysis. This is something that happens in every loop whenever his father-in-law falls in love.
“By the way, Rafu’s kids are brilliant, but they aren’t quite that mischievous. He’s the hidden boss.”
“The hidden boss?”
“Rafu.”
Big Sister is hiding her face as if using the Raph-species as a shield. Her cheeks are slightly red—perhaps she doesn’t want to get involved in this conversation.
“Wait, are we still going on about this?”

“Well, Naofumi, you might as well listen while we’re at it. Naofumi’s kids are basically full of energy and take after their mother. Don’t worry—they’ll be born more on the Demi-Human side, to the point where they’ll be considered Demi-Humans rather than a hybrid. Oh, and they’ll inherit traits from Naofumi, so you’ll be able to tell they’re your biological children—don’t worry.”
“How is that reassuring? It sounds kind of vague…”
“So you mean they won’t be a mixed-blood who’s neither one thing nor the other!?”

“Exactly. In the case of Imiya-neechan’s child, they were born with the ability to shift between Beastman and Demi-Human forms. In their Demi-Human form, you’ll just sort of know they’re Naofumi’s child.”
Is that the child of the Mole and my Father? Ah… I can only vaguely recall that.
“Even considering we’ve been looping, I’m still skeptical about the extent of that, Gaelion-san.”
“What are you talking about? I’m talking about them being the Hero’s children. The Bow Hero.”
At this point, the Rival emphasized to Itsuki, “The Bow Hero.” Even my Father, who had been looking exasperated, naturally turned his gaze toward Itsuki and Ren.
“W-what…!?”
“The Bow Hero—you and Rishia’s child was born looking just as lively and full of energy. That’s not something you can just blurt out to Naofumi.”

By the way, it seems Riska has fully recovered from her recent shock, as she’s been active and energetic without Itsuki needing to look after her. She’s going about her business as Riska, wearing the costume the Rival gave her. However, since Itsuki goes missing from time to time, her interactions are limited to just a brief chat with Fleon-chan.
“What kind of child is Ju and Rishia’s child?”
“In a world where the Bow Hero survived unscathed—as far as Gaelion remembers—there was a girl and a boy. The girl was the one with the more distinctive personality.”
“Huh… In what way was she unique?”
“The Spear Hero would actually know more about that.”
“Motoyasu-kun?”

My Rival has thrown the topic my way. He’s looking at me with sparkling eyes, just as his Father seems interested. Itsuki seems to be turning pale, as if he’s about to hear something scary. Hmm… Is this about Itsuki and Riska’s child? Why am I being treated as the expert on this? I wondered, but the memory is slowly coming back to me.
“Itsuki and Riska’s child was close friends with Filolial-sama, wasn’t she?”
That’s certainly true. Perhaps because she’d been with Filolial-sama since childhood, I remember that she was always by Filolial-sama’s side and they got along very well.
“Spear Hero, tell me more details—he was so unique.”
“Unique, you say? I wonder if he surpassed that self-assertive pig before I came to this world?”
“I know Motoyasu-kun has a lot of romantic experience, but…”
“Ah, I remember he had a vivid imagination. That energy of his was somewhat reminiscent of Riska, but there’s no doubt he was even more energetic than her.”

“At bedtime, when trying to sleep in a darkened room, she’d let her imagination run wild and scream at the top of her lungs, ‘If I stay up like this, the Cabbage Man will come and take me away and lock me inside a cabbage! I’m doomed!’ She’d get scolded by Naofumi, only to scream even louder.”

Ah, that sounds familiar. So, with no other choice, I started sleeping with Filolial-sama. She was the kind of child who could talk with Filolial-sama for hours on end. She’d snuggle up tight and be surrounded by lots of Filolial-samas.
“Even though she was a negative daydreamer, she was high-energy and full of life.”
“She certainly seems unique and full of energy. Is ‘Cabbage Uncle’ an imaginary friend?”
At this point, Itsuki rested his hand on his chin and made a gesture as if deep in thought.
“Cabbage Uncle… Naofumi, doesn’t your ‘Shield Prison’ skill look like a cabbage at first glance?”
“Could you please not turn me into that Cabbage Uncle?”
“But when you put all the characteristics together, it naturally feels like my future child will recognize Naofumi as Cabbage Uncle. This is an unshakable fact.”
“And then there’s the whole Kou thing, too,” Itsuki added emphatically.

“If a kid is misbehaving, not listening, and causing trouble for others, I think discipline is unavoidable. But is that kid just a troublemaker? Or is it more like, ‘Well, he was raised by Filolials’ or something like that? Itsuki and Rishia in that world seem pretty busy, too.”
So, was there a problem with how Itsuki and the others raised him? That’s the question, isn’t it?

“His negativity seems to be innate. He’s not really a troublemaker, either. She’s a good kid at heart, but that ‘Since my parents are heroes, I can’t be spoiled. If I act spoiled, I’ll be a burden and Uncle Cabbage will come…’ combo would go off, leaving even the Bow Heroes baffled.”
“Hmm… In a word, she sounds like a handful. A kid who panics easily… or something like that?”
“That wasn’t a mental disorder—it was more a matter of personality.”
“She got along well with Filolial-sama and the others, though. She was always playing with Filolial-sama.”
“So she really clicked with the carefree Filolials, didn’t she?”
“I guess you could say she’s energetic. To sum it up, does that mean children of heroes tend to be exceptionally talented?”
“To the point where they’d almost tear their mother’s belly open!”
Itsuki’s line really packs a punch.
“Eek! My Big Sister’s kid is so energetic, it’s a real headache!”
